LESSON: IMPORTANCE OF EATING FOOD

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Our Family
Topic 2.2: Importance of Eating Food
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Importance of Eating Food, part of Our Family in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we eat food? 2. How do we clean fruits before eating?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Importance of Eating Food together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: learner develops skills of speaking audibly when story telling the importance of eating food

Values:
Responsibility: A Learner develops responsibility as they wash fruits before eating.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Communicable and non-communicable diseases: learner is able to prevent diseases by eating clean food.

Link to other learning area:

A learner is able to relate story telling the importance of eating food to story telling as learnt in Language Activities

Suggested Learning Resources

Water, basins, spoons, plates, dishes, fruits, cups, a variety of foods, pictures of food, video clips and digital devices with assistive technology.
